I'm sorry, this is your third contact about a lost $210 order, and I understand why you're furious. Because this is a repeat issue (third time) and the refund is over $150, I'm escalating it to a Support Lead who can review and decide on the refund.

The policy I have doesn't cover lost-in-transit orders specifically, so I can't promise a full refund or a timeframe for the decision. If you share your order number (it looks like LF-123456), I'll include it in the escalation so you don't have to repeat yourself. Please don't send any card numbers or passwords.
